Recorded claim:
`desktop/main.cjs` provides Electron lifecycle, single-instance behavior, tray persistence, secure `WebContentsView` pages, reusable same-origin windows, navigation controls, and a console server that remains available after the main window closes. Package with `npm run desktop:package`; smoke-test with `npm run desktop:smoke -- Working comm checkout`. [Task 1]
